raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The raw_transactions source column is now named txn_amount and no `amount` column exists, so the silver_transactions binder fails. The values in txn_amount (USD only, 2.55 to 586.46, two decimals) look like the same dollar amounts, so mapping txn_amount to amount restores the pipeline without changing its meaning.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(txn_amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
